body: swifties, a tag page is a pile. her closet deserves a timeline, so that's what our runway thread is, her looks laid out era by era. begin with 2011's speak now world tour, all castles and sweeping gowns, and tell me you aren't swooning 👗 https://longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

critique.rationale: Says why the Runway thread exists (looks in order instead of a tag-page pile) and grounds it in one sourced look, the Speak Now World Tour gowns and staged sets. The 2011 Love Story tour photo is that exact look, so the image carries the point.

why: Runway thread hero, window 11-11→15, angle origin-story (ANGLES[(3+2)%5]). Different look from 10-30's Oscar de la Renta quiz: speak-now.mjs 'The ballgown tour' (CBS News/60 Minutes, Taste of Country). Hook = direct address, no question lead. X half written first; no screenshot (never on X).
